subject: Private Offer: regional surcharge allocations & channel tax treatment
messages:
From: Timothy Sandoval <timothy.sandoval@orisonhealth.com>
To: chloe.martin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orisonhealth.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Private offer question — regional surcharge & tax passthrough

Hi Chloe,

Quick follow on the latest private offer PDF you sent (thanks). Two items procurement flagged while reviewing finance:

1) Regional surcharge allocation: we see a 3% regional surcharge line in the private offer. Will that be invoiced by Redwood directly to Orison, or will that surcharge be applied by our reseller (ResellerCorp) and passed through on their invoice? Our AR team needs clarity because of our invoice routing rules.

2) Channel tax treatment: ResellerCorp operates as a reseller for our territory and claims a tax-exempt pass-through in several states. Can Redwood accept the reseller's tax-exemption certificate (we can share it) and net taxes on your invoice (i.e., Redwood bills Orison net of sales tax), or do you require the reseller to collect and remit and then pass-through the surcharge?

We also want to understand whether channel margin (the commission we agreed) will be calculated on list price before surcharge or net of surcharge. Small differences here change our accounting.

Attached is the private offer we reviewed. If you can confirm the preferred invoice path and any evidence you need from the reseller (tax cert, reseller agreement excerpt), we can get it over to you this week.

Thanks — Tim

--
Timothy Sandoval

Tim — really appreciate the clear ask. Looping in Irene (pricing ops) and Ben (channel ops) so we can answer thoroughly. High-level answers first, then items we need from your side: 

Summary answers (short):
- Surcharge invoicing: Redwood prefers to invoice Orison directly for the 3% regional surcharge as a separate line item on the Redwood invoice.
- Tax treatment: We can accept a reseller tax-exemption certificate and invoice Orison net of sales tax only if ResellerCorp provides a completed resale certificate and a signed reseller addendum confirming they will not collect/reclaim tax for this transaction.
- Channel margin basis: Commission will be calculated on the list price (pre-surcharge) unless we explicitly agree to a net-of-surcharge calculation in writing.

What we need from you / ResellerCorp to proceed:
- Reseller resale certificate(s) for the states Orison will be billed in (PDF).
- Signed reseller addendum excerpt confirming invoice routing and tax handling (one-page acceptable).
- Confirmation whether Orison requires the reseller to be the billing party for contractual reasons (some customers mandate reseller invoices). If so, we can provide an alternative flow where ResellerCorp invoices you and Redwood issues a credit memo for the channel commission portion — but that adds reconciliation steps.

Irene — can you confirm whether net invoicing (Redwood invoices Orison net of sales tax) needs legal approval for the US states listed below, and whether there's any merchant-of-record limitation? Ben — if net tax is acceptable, can the channel margin calculation be locked to list price in our deal system?

Proposed next step: Tim, if you can share the reseller tax files in reply and confirm invoice party preference (Redwood vs ResellerCorp), I'll prepare two short invoice-path diagrams and the rescindable addendum for signature.

Thanks — Chloe

--

Subject: RE: Private offer question — regional surcharge & tax passthrough

Thanks for the evidence and the clear preference, Tim / Procurement. Quick internal recap and final ask so we can finalize the private offer this week.

1) Tax & invoice party — Decision and impact
- We can accept ResellerCorp's resale certificates and proceed with Redwood invoicing Orison net of sales tax. Legal has confirmed (US states listed in the attachment) that this flow is acceptable provided we receive:
  * The signed reseller addendum (received)
  * State-by-state resale certificate PDFs (received in the zip)
- Operational impact: Redwood will bill Orison directly. ResellerCorp will issue a commission invoice to Redwood monthly (as standard). No extra credit memos required in this flow.

2) Surcharge & channel margin calculation — decision options
Option A (standard, preferred by Redwood):
- 3% regional surcharge applied as a discrete invoice line on the Redwood invoice.
- Channel commission calculated on list price (pre-surcharge). This keeps commissions stable and avoids complicated pass-through math.

Option B (Orison's preference - net-of-surcharge commission):
- Redwood can accept net-of-surcharge commission for this deal as an exception, provided Orison signs a short amendment that documents the exception and accepts the one-time reconciliation approach (see below).
- Reconciliation delta: because commission will be calculated on net, ResellerCorp's payout will be ~2.91% of list price instead of 3.00% (example: $100k list -> $3k vs $2,910). Redwood will capture the small rounding/reconciliation difference and commit to a single end-of-quarter report for transparency.

Recommendation: To minimize accounting churn, we recommend Option A. However, we are happy to accept Option B if Orison signs the simple amendment linked below. If you go with Option B, Ben will prepare the commission workback and we will include the end-of-quarter reconciliation report in the deal pack.

Next steps / timeline
- If you confirm Redwood invoicing Orison (preferred), we will:
  * Publish updated private offer (v4) with explicit invoice party and surcharge line by end of day Wed 08/05.
  * Share the one-page amendment to capture net-of-surcharge commission (only if you choose Option B).
  * Provide a sample Redwood invoice template so your AP can validate routing.

Links & attachments
- Updated action tracker (internal): https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98421
- Doc: short amendment (draft): https://drive.google.com/drafts/RDW-98421-amendment

Ben — please prepare the commission workback (Option B) and a sample payout table. Irene / Legal — retweet if any state-specific legal blockers show up in the evidence.

Tim / Linda — can you confirm by EOD Wed which option you want? If we get confirmation, I'll push the v4 private offer and DocuSign route.

Thanks — Chloe
